title: Evidence requests that ask only for the gap
scope: Propose itemised evidence requests from Lekuka/ASYCUDA mismatches and assurance findings so the taxpayer sees what RSL already holds and answers only the unmatched lines (confirm, dispute or attach proof)

acceptance.text: A proposed request lists what is already matched and itemises only unmatched lines with confirm, dispute or attach-proof answers; an officer approves it before it reaches the taxpayer
The request never asks for data RSL holds and never shows risk scores or officer findings
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Tests on TAX-118 synthetic taxpayers: requests contain only unmatched lines; approval is required

notes.text: Added 2026-11-07 from ADR-043 (Vati downstream of RSL selection; portal answers evidence requests).
2026-11-11 (ADR-045): owner changed from Keletso to Gupta; RSL integration lane. No task in this lane depends on an open task in the other lane.
